storyCards.headline: Don't Walk Away: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Jade's "Don't Walk Away" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Don't Walk Away" is a song by American R&B group Jade, released in November 1992, by Giant Records, as the second single from their debut album, Jade to the Max (1992).

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 35 weeks on the chart.

Don't Walk Away was released in 1993.
